Why This Is Asked
This tests practical config of CI/CD with ECS blue/green and canary, plus secure secret handling and least-privilege IAM.

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:

      - npm ci
      - npm test
      - docker build -t $REPOSITORY_URI:$CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION .

      - docker push $REPOSITORY_URI:$CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates your understanding of disaster recovery strategies, cross-region data replication, and automated failover workflows using managed AWS services.

## Key Concepts
- Cross-region disaster recovery with warm standby architecture
- Route 53 failover routing with health checks for automatic traffic steering
- DynamoDB Global Tables for multi-region data consistency
- CloudFormation modularization for DR resource deployment
- CodePipeline promotion and rollback strategies

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation for us-west-2 DR ECS and Route 53
Resources:
  DRCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-dr-cluster
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled

  DRTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-api
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: api
          Image: !Ref DockerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80

  DRService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref DRCluster
      ServiceName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-api-service
      TaskDefinition: !Ref DRTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 2
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets: !Ref DRSubnets
          SecurityGroups: !Ref DRSecurityGroups

  PrimaryHealthCheck:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: HTTP
        FullyQualifiedName: primary-api.example.com
        Port: 80
        ResourcePath: /health
        RequestInterval: 10
        FailureThreshold: 3

  FailoverRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      Name: api.example.com
      Type: A
      SetIdentifier: primary
      FailoverRecordSet:
        Type: PRIMARY
        HealthCheckId: !Ref PrimaryHealthCheck
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !GetAtt PrimaryALB.DNSName
        HostedZoneId: !GetAtt PrimaryALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID

  SecondaryRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      Name: api.example.com
      Type: A
      SetIdentifier: dr
      FailoverRecordSet:
        Type: SECONDARY
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !GetAtt DRALB.DNSName
        HostedZoneId: !GetAtt DRALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
```

```yaml
# Minimal IAM policy snippet (illustrative)
Resources:
  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: XRayAndLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ["xray:PutTraceSegments","xray:PutTelemetryRecords"]
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ["logs:CreateLogGroup","logs:CreateLogStream","logs:PutLogEvents"]
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
```
